name: @proworks-hub/taxiq
description: TaxIQ — tax determination where an unmapped item is undetermined (never default-taxable, never default-exempt), nexus is a windowed function whose partial history can establish an obligation but never refute one, exemption is per-jurisdiction with evidence or nothing, rounding is a versioned per-jurisdiction method (never a setting), and a superseded determination adjusts the current period rather than rewriting a filed one.
author: Steven Kreutzer
